d: Group Human Resources Director | Retail & GCC
A leading and fast-growing retail group is seeking an experienced Group Human Resources Director to lead the next stage of its people and organizational transformation.
The group employs 2,000+ people across multiple business units, with operations in Kuwait and other GCC markets.

This is a senior leadership role with direct access to the CEO and executive management. The successful candidate will have broad ownership of the people agenda, with the mandate to strengthen the HR operating model, improve organizational effectiveness and redefine how HR supports business performance and growth.
Lead the overall HR strategy and function across talent acquisition, HR operations, compensation and benefits, performance management, employee relations, organizational development and learning.
Partner with the CEO and executive leadership on organizational structure, leadership capability, workforce strategy and business growth.
Strengthen organizational design, job architecture, grading, salary structures and compensation frameworks.
Improve manpower planning, budgeting and workforce productivity across business units and GCC operations.
Upgrade the performance management and appraisal process to create meaningful differentiation, accountability and stronger linkage between individual performance and business results.
Strengthen senior leadership hiring, succession planning and internal leadership pipelines.
Improve the quality, speed and effectiveness of recruitment across the organization.
Develop practical retention strategies for Kuwait and GCC markets, particularly for critical and high-performing talent.
Ensure effective governance of multinational payroll, HR reporting and employment compliance.
Strengthen the use of HR systems, analytics and workforce data to support better management decisions.
Build a capable HR leadership team and ensure that the function operates with appropriate accountability, service levels and business orientation.
Lead major HR transformation and change initiatives while ensuring that processes remain practical, efficient and appropriate for a fast-moving business.
15+ years of progressive HR experience, including significant leadership responsibility at Director, Senior Director, Head of HR or equivalent level.
Proven ownership of a broad, end-to-end HR function in a sizeable and complex organization.
Strong experience in retail, consumer, FMCG, hospitality or another large frontline-workforce environment.
Experience supporting or leading HR for a workforce of approximately 2,000 employees or more.
Demonstrated success in HR transformation, organizational design, manpower planning, performance management and workforce productivity.
Strong experience recruiting senior leaders through direct sourcing, market mapping, headhunting or executive search.
Experience managing HR across multiple GCC markets is strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of Kuwait and GCC employment practices.
Commercial mindset with the ability to balance HR governance with business speed and operational requirements.
Direct exposure to the CEO and executive leadership.
Genuine authority to shape the people strategy and HR operating model.
Broad GCC scope across multiple businesses.
Opportunity to lead meaningful organizational transformation rather than simply maintain existing HR processes.
A highly visible role where HR initiatives will directly influence growth, productivity, leadership capability and organizational performance.

Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out. Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

An individual-contributor operational role responsible for coordinating and administering DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) orders, consignment orders and shipments, Special Orders and Client Orders, Return-to-Vendor (RTV) activities, and related shipping documentation and invoice controls. The role works closely with internal stakeholders, consignment partners, couriers, freight forwarders, vendors and relevant support functions to ensure orders and shipments are properly documented, tracked and processed in accordance with company procedures and applicable Qatar Customs requirements. The role supports day-to-day supply chain continuity, accurate record keeping, timely delivery, and accurate submission of courier invoices and shipping-related procurement documents.
Liaise with internal stakeholders and consignment partners to coordinate range plans, consignment agreements, delivery schedules, shipping instructions and shipment-specific requirements.

Review, validate and process consignment orders and shipments in line with company policies, procedures and applicable Qatar Customs regulations; obtain required approvals in accordance with delegated authority.
Monitor consignment shipments and coordinate with couriers and freight forwarders for status updates, issue resolution and delivery within agreed timelines.
Maintain an organized digital/shared-point filing structure for consignment orders and supporting documents to ensure traceability, accessibility, compliance and audit readiness.
Coordinate and manage Special Orders and Client Orders, following up with relevant parties to support timely and accurate fulfilment.
Provide operational support for Return-to-Vendor (RTV) requests, including coordination, documentation and follow-up in accordance with established procedures.
Review courier invoices against shipment records and supporting documents, verify accuracy and authorization, resolve discrepancies, and submit approved invoices for payment processing on time.

Initiate and process Purchase Requisitions (PRs) and Purchase Orders (POs) for shipping-related expenses associated with Client Orders, Special Orders and non-sellable shipments, following procurement procedures.

Ensure electronically attested documentation for Direct Orders is maintained and original attested documents are accurately filed and securely retained in accordance with record-keeping and compliance requirements.
Provide end-to-end operational support for DDP orders, including shipment-document review, verification, approval coordination, shipment tracking and follow-up with relevant stakeholders.
Track DDP shipments through to delivery and proactively coordinate with couriers, freight forwarders and internal stakeholders to address discrepancies and delays.

Analysis: Maintain trackers for DDP and consignment shipments, Special/Client Orders, RTV requests and courier invoices; provide status updates and highlight delays, discrepancies and pending actions.
People Management: No direct reports are indicated for this role. Coordinate work across internal teams and external service providers.
Innovation: Identify opportunities to improve order tracking, document control, invoice verification and follow-up processes; recommend practical process improvements.

The role sits within the supply chain / operations function and supports order administration, shipment coordination, consignment operations, DDP deliveries, special and client-specific orders, RTV activities, shipping documentation and courier invoice controls. It operates in a procedure-led environment requiring regular coordination with internal stakeholders and external suppliers and logistics service providers. The role is primarily office-based and involves electronic records, order/shipment trackers, document review and frequent follow-up to meet delivery and submission timelines. The position must follow company policies and applicable Qatar Customs requirements and escalate non-standard issues or approvals through the appropriate channels.
